uncovered_item_details.paper_location: Main Eqs. (1)-(2), PDF p. 2, versus Supplement Eqs. (1)-(4), PDF p. 7
uncovered_item_details.scientific_object: Consistency of the printed dissipative rates: the supplement's Bloch/Liouvillian rates are twice the literal main-text rates under the printed standard dissipator
direct_gap_statements: Literal expansion of Main Eqs. (1)-(2) gives dissipative coefficients exactly one half of Supplement Eqs. (1)-(4); no single paper-exact gamma-prime convention satisfies both printed definitions.

direct_cause.statement: Literal expansion of Main Eqs. (1)-(2) gives dissipative coefficients exactly one half of Supplement Eqs. (1)-(4); no single paper-exact gamma-prime convention satisfies both printed definitions.

root_cause.statement: The printed standard dissipator and rates in Main Eqs. (1)-(2) cannot produce Supplement Eqs. (1)-(4) at the same gamma-prime; the remaining question is the paper-level adjudication of typo versus unprinted convention.

code_fault_assessment.statement: No reproduction-code defect was found: three distinct checks reproduce the same exact factor-two relation while the figure-consistent and literal generators remain separate.

checks.statement: The standard dissipator, both printed rates, gamma-prime definition, and Supplemental matrix coefficients were traced to their exact paper locations.
Direct operator expansion of the printed standard dissipator yields the literal main-text coefficients.
A separately assembled 4x4 density-matrix Liouvillian reproduces the factor-two steady-state shift.
The literal generator at gamma-prime equals the supplement/figure generator at gamma-prime divided by two across four anchors.

next_discriminating_test.action: Have a fresh-context reviewer independently expand both printed generators and audit the full paper, publication record, and any formal erratum for an alternative rate convention.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: A documented convention closes T011 as consistent; otherwise the stable factor-two mismatch can be promoted only by the fresh claim-level review to a paper-error candidate.

next_discriminating_actions: Have a fresh-context reviewer independently expand both printed generators and audit the full paper, publication record, and any formal erratum for an alternative rate convention.

uncovered_item_details.paper_location: Main experimental paragraph, PDF p. 3, versus Main Eq. (1), PDF p. 2, and Supplement Eqs. (1)-(4), PDF p. 7
uncovered_item_details.scientific_object: Consistency of H=Omega sigma_x in prose with H=Omega sigma_x/2 in all executable equations and the standard Rabi convention
direct_gap_statements: The experimental prose writes H=Omega sigma_x, while Main Eq. (1), Supplement Eqs. (1)-(4), and the figure-generating dynamics use H=Omega sigma_x/2.

direct_cause.statement: The experimental prose writes H=Omega sigma_x, while Main Eq. (1), Supplement Eqs. (1)-(4), and the figure-generating dynamics use H=Omega sigma_x/2.

root_cause.statement: The experimental prose states H=Omega sigma_x while Main Eq. (1), every Supplemental equation, and the standard Rabi-frequency convention use H=Omega sigma_x/2; the remaining question is typo versus an unprinted local redefinition.

code_fault_assessment.statement: No implementation defect was found after source-parameter audit, exact energy-gap rederivation, an independent density-matrix generator, and the Rabi-frequency invariant test.

checks.statement: Omega was traced through the experimental prose, Main Eq. (1), Supplemental Eqs. (1)-(7), and the gamma-prime definition.
H=Omega sigma_x/2 has eigenvalue gap Omega, whereas H=Omega sigma_x has gap 2 Omega.
The separately assembled density-matrix Liouvillian contains the coherent generator from H=Omega sigma_x/2 and reproduces the Supplemental Bloch equations.
The Hamiltonian eigenvalue-gap invariant identifies the equation convention as the one consistent with the stated Rabi frequency.

next_discriminating_test.action: Have a fresh-context reviewer trace the definition of Omega through the experimental pulse description, Main Eq. (1), the supplement, and the formal publication or erratum record.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: An explicit local Rabi-frequency convention resolves the sentence; absent that, the reviewer may retain or promote the source discrepancy under the paper-error contract.
